rows.reason: Since portal c09fea54 (2.0.0_SA_COO~P, 2026-09-22, 'reject private and malformed public status wires') contracts/public-status.ts requirePublicStatus refuses a present non-date business_date, so the parser throws EnvelopeMismatch('status') on the explicit-null arm before any panel exists (probe at 7bb81fa8: absent {} passes, {business_date: null} throws). The contract rule 'ABSENT, NEVER NULL' is still honoured, more strictly: a null is now refused at the boundary rather than rendered as a producer defect. Replace the arm with 'the parser refuses an explicit-null business_date; an absent one renders NO_SOURCE_AGE_YET'. Existing live test of the refusal: __tests__/mvp-selection/public-status.test.ts. No ruling retires the old arm.
